=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3748-3749,5491-5492 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Both late-run cancel lookups (LATE_IMPL_RUN_IDS in "Cleanup test artifacts", ALT_ACTIVE_IMPL_IDS in "Cleanup alt-model artifacts") query `repos/${TEST_REPO}/actions/workflows/implement.yml/runs`, but implement.yml is `workflow_call`-only (.github/workflows/implement.yml:4-5) and owns no runs; the runs are recorded under the caller (internal-implement.yml:47 here, ai-implement.yml in consumer repos).
  WHY: The listing comes back empty or as a swallowed 404 (`2>/dev/null || true` / `|| echo ""`), so no queued or pending Implement run is ever cancelled and a late run still opens an ai/issue-<N> smoke PR (#8239, #8346 and the rest) that only the sweep backstop closes, up to 6 hours later. Tests tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_smoke_pr_cleanup.py and tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_alt_model_cleanup_pr_selector.py pin the broken endpoint. The correct pattern is find_latest_scoped_run_field (scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh:218-250), which queries /actions/runs with a `.name | test("Implement"; "i")` filter. All four reviewers rated it BLOCKER.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3748-3750,5491-5494 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Each active-run lookup reads only the newest single page (per_page=100 in main cleanup, per_page=20 in alt-model) with no page loop; the bounded page loop was lost with editor_changes_lost (run 43034382624).
  WHY: A stuck queued or pending run is usually among the oldest in the created=> window, so it falls off page 1 and is never cancelled. A release window has held 166 runs, and internal-implement fires on every issue_comment. All four reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4865-4876 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The branch-delete retry loop in "Cleanup orchestrate test issues" treats a 404 (orchestrator/project-<N> never pushed or already gone) like a real DELETE failure: it sleeps about 6 s, then emits `::warning::Could not delete branch ${PROJECT_BRANCH} after 3 attempts`; the earlier "already absent" check was lost with editor_changes_lost.
  WHY: The false warnings train operators to ignore real delete failures (RBAC, protected branch). All four reviewers rated it NIT.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3748-3749,5491-5492 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Both late-run lookups swallow API failures silently (`2>/dev/null || true` and `2>/dev/null || echo ""`) and emit no `::warning::`.
  WHY: A transient 5xx or network failure that hides a real pending run looks the same as "no matches", and the log never shows that the lookup ran. Rated NIT; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 raised the same point only as a hardening suggestion.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:n/a (jobs tests-hooks-and-orchestrator and orchestrate-poll (2), run 42852534125, head 441d75a) | severity=high | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: Two required CI shards are red on the PR head, so the lint aggregator fails and the PR cannot merge. The failure was not mapped to a hunk; the suspected cause is the extra get_issue_state_labels_json GET (line 4815) added by judge_tracking_issue_closed_skip at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh lines 34047-34048.
  WHY: Merge stays blocked until the failing test names from run 42852534125 are pulled and the cause is fixed or shown to be inherited. Rated MAJOR.
- PR description / commit history:n/a | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The PR body and commit message use auto-close keywords (Fixes/Closes/Resolves) to reference ai:orchestrator-tracking issue #2734.
  WHY: This violates §21/§19; on merge GitHub would auto-close the tracking issue and stop wave dispatch. Rated BLOCKER. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputes it: the annotations come from fixture cases in tests/test_lint_pr_body_auto_close.py, not from this PR's body.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "e2e-smoke-test cleanup. When PR_NUMBER is empty: cancel any queued, pending or in-progress Implement run for the smoke issue, using the run the gate already tracks in Phase 3b ... Apply the same lookup in e2e-alt-model-test cleanup. The run cancel prevents a late PR." (Issue #8953, Approach 1)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, "Cleanup test artifacts" (lines 3743-3758) and "Cleanup alt-model artifacts" (lines 5486-5499)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Both hunks exist but do not reuse the Phase 3b selection (find_latest_scoped_run_field, or /actions/runs with an "Implement" name regex); they list actions/workflows/implement.yml/runs, a workflow_call-only file (implement.yml lines 4-5) that owns no runs, so no Implement run is ever cancelled; tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_smoke_pr_cleanup.py pins the non-working endpoint (`assert "actions/workflows/implement.yml/runs?per_page=100${LATE_IMPL_CREATED_FILTER}" in fallback`); no test checks that the cleanup finds a caller's runs for a workflow_call-only file. Both reviewers rated it BLOCKER.
- requirement: "PR Body Auto-Close Keyword Discipline": the PR body and commit messages must not use auto-close keywords (Fixes, Closes, Resolves, …) followed by a reference to an ai:orchestrator-tracking issue
  expected_change_site: PR body (shows `Fixes #2734`) and a commit message on the branch (shows `resolved: #2734`)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: lint check-run (run 42852534125) failed with `##[error][lint_pr_body_auto_close] PR body:line 1 — auto-close keyword 'Fixes' references ai:orchestrator-tracking issue #2734` and `commit message #2:line 3 — auto-close keyword 'resolved' references ai:orchestrator-tracking issue #2734`; same pattern as PR #2760 (docs/postmortems/2026-05-18-project-2734-stall.md). Both reviewers rated it BLOCKER; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this gap as coming from tests/test_lint_pr_body_auto_close.py fixtures.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3748, 5491 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: LATE_IMPL_RUN_IDS (line 3748) and ALT_ACTIVE_IMPL_IDS (line 5491) list runs of actions/workflows/implement.yml, which is workflow_call-only (implement.yml lines 4-5). The real callers are internal-implement.yml (line 47, "Internal: AI Implement") and the consumer ai-implement.yml wrapper ("AI Implement"). The previous code used find_latest_scoped_run_field (scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh lines 232-247) with `.name | test("Implement"; "i")`.
  WHY: The empty listing or 404 is swallowed by `2>/dev/null || true` / `|| echo ""`, so no Implement run is cancelled and the late smoke PR (#8239, #8346) stays open until the sweep backstop runs, up to 6 h later. Tests tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_smoke_pr_cleanup.py and tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_alt_model_cleanup_pr_selector.py pin the broken endpoint. Suggested fix: query repos/${TEST_REPO}/actions/runs?per_page=100&page=${page}${LATE_IMPL_CREATED_FILTER} with select(.name | test("Implement"; "i")) over a bounded page loop, and update both tests.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3748-3749, 5491-5492 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Each lookup reads a single page (per_page=100 / per_page=20, no page parameter); the bounded page loop was lost with editor_changes_lost.
  WHY: On a busy test repo, internal-implement fires on every issue_comment, so a stuck old run falls off page 1 and is never cancelled. Suggested fix: the same page loop as find_latest_scoped_run_field (stop at a short, empty or failed page; for alt-model also stop at .id <= PRE_IMPLEMENT).
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (jobs tests-hooks-and-orchestrator and orchestrate-poll (2), run 42852534125, head 441d75a) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Two required CI shards are red, so lint fails and merge is blocked; the failure could not be mapped to a hunk. The suspected hunk is scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh lines 34047-34048 (judge_tracking_issue_closed_skip), which adds a get_issue_state_labels_json GET (line 4815) on every in_progress judge cycle with NEW_ISSUES_COUNT == 0.
  WHY: Merge stays blocked until the failing test names are pulled from the run 42852534125 logs and the cause is fixed or shown to be inherited.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4865-4876 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The branch-delete loop treats a missing ref as a real failure: it sleeps 2 s and 4 s, then warns "Could not delete branch ${PROJECT_BRANCH} after 3 attempts"; the "already absent" check was lost with editor_changes_lost.
  WHY: The false warnings hide real leaks. Suggested fix: GET git/ref/heads/${PROJECT_BRANCH} after a failed DELETE; on a 404, log "already absent" and break.
- TASK_GAP | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  Requirement: "e2e-smoke-test cleanup. When PR_NUMBER is empty: cancel any queued, pending or in-progress Implement run for the smoke issue, using the run the gate already tracks in Phase 3b ... Apply the same lookup in e2e-alt-model-test cleanup. The run cancel prevents a late PR."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, "Cleanup test artifacts" (lines 3743-3758) and "Cleanup alt-model artifacts" (lines 5486-5499).
  Evidence of absence: Neither hunk reuses the Phase 3b selection; both list actions/workflows/implement.yml/runs, a workflow_call-only file, so no run is cancelled; the contract tests pin the non-working endpoint.
- HARDENING (risk score 2): .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml lines 3748-3749 and 5491-5492. `2>/dev/null || true` / `|| echo ""` hide a failed lookup; emit "::warning::Implement run lookup failed for issue #${ISSUE_NUMBER}" on a non-zero exit (3 lines per site).
- Rejected pass-1 claims: (1) Gemini's wave-advance short-circuit claim at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh lines 34047-34048 is wrong, because both the open-issue and closed-issue outcomes are correct. (2) Gemini's "Fixes #2734" TASK_GAP is wrong, because the annotations come from fixtures in tests/test_lint_pr_body_auto_close.py. (2 related items)
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
